source_feature_filter: none; every source record enters Tippecanoe independently
line_joining: none; no concatenation by segmentID, segmentInd, tile or proximity
dateline: Split only crossing source parts at +/-180 in display geometry; analytical XY bytes remain unchanged
width: Original width_m in metres; value1 is missing, represented by width_valid=false and a muted thin stroke
low_zoom: Individual roughly30m observations are unsuitable as a world overview. This detail layer begins at zoom8; no faulty summary fallback or fabricated connecting edges.
maxzoom_coverage: All source IDs must appear, except individually enumerated geometries that collapse at the frozen quantization; unexpected loss fails
